title: 6.3 Biomes of Ethiopia
description: Major biomes in Ethiopia including afroalpine, montane forest, savanna, desert, and aquatic ecosystems with endemic species

options: Tall trees forming a dense canopy
Low temperatures and high solar radiation
Sandy soil with very little vegetation
